title: Under the door
logline: Wednesday. The eviction notice comes under the garage door as a hand and an envelope. The tavern's landlord is a hand. The amount is drawn; the name on the notice isn't.

panels.composition: The garage door, from inside, morning. An envelope sliding under it, pushed by fingers. BARNABY watching the fingers.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, seen from inside a garage, an envelope being pushed under the door by a hand's fingers, a small dog watching the fingers

panels.composition: The envelope on the concrete. NOTICE, in a rubber-stamp face. The dog's nose on it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, close-up of an envelope stamped NOTICE lying on a concrete floor with a small dog's nose touching it

panels.composition: WOOD reading it at the table. The figure: $640. Ten days. The landlord's name: a blank shape where a signature would be.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a man reading a notice at a drafting table in a dark garage, a blank shape where a signature would be
image.notes: Letter after: $640 · TEN DAYS. The tavern's name and the landlord's: reserved, blank.

panels.composition: Wood at the CRT. The serious page on the screen. 41 views still. His face lit blue. The notice under the mug. Something starting.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a man's face lit blue by a CRT monitor in a dark garage with a notice pinned under a coffee mug beside him, something beginning in his expression, no words
